design.rules: Arabic never in image-model pixels; typography added in post. Symbols/times in Inter LTR. Logo from assets/brand only.

slides.en:
This week can move gold.
5 dates. Istanbul time.
slides.ar:
أسبوع قد يحرّك الذهب...
خمسة مواعيد بتوقيت إسطنبول

slides.visual: Minimal descending line motif in #FF5C7A, no price axis, no invented numbers.
Large Inter time (up to 120px), teal underline, bank-building line icon.

Rates and the dollar are two of gold's main drivers.
We mark the moments, not the direction.

imagePrompts.prompt: Abstract dark navy (#0B1320) background with a subtle teal (#00D4A7) calendar grid and soft glow, premium fintech editorial style, large empty space for text, no text, no numbers, no logos, no people, 4:5 vertical.
imagePrompts.negative: text, letters, digits, price charts with numbers, watermarks, logos, faces

imagePrompts.prompt: Set of four minimal line icons in teal on transparent/dark background: bank building, bar chart, globe with currency symbols (no real currency glyph text), flow arrows. Consistent stroke, flat, no text.

productionNotes: Generate backgrounds only; compose text/logo in an external editor. Each generated image needs separate cost preview/approval per GENERATION.md. Verify every claim in market-brief.md §1 before export.
